==Description==
The '''End of Summer Season''' was the sixth season to be added to Tower Defense Simulator. It was a summer-themed season which required {{Shells|Shells}} to reach higher ranks. This season was not connected to an event.

This season started on the 5th of August 2022 and has ended on the 30th of September 2022.

==Trivia==
*The '''End of Summer Season''' was the second Season that is not connected to an event, with the first one being the [[Season of Love]].
*Strangely, [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode did not give you any {{Shells|Shells}}.
*Oddly, the {{Color|EndOfSummer|Barbecue}} [[Pyromancer]] and [[Golden Pyromancer]] skin in the '''End of Summer Season''' was called ''BBQ'', despite the skin actually being named ''Barbecue''.
**The official update log for the [[v1.3.1|End of Summer Update]] also called this skin ''Barbeque'', this is also incorrect.
*The '''End of Summer Season''' was originally supposed to end on the 22nd of September 2022, but was extended to the 7th of October 2022 to test multi-season support in the [[v1.4.0|Wanted Dead Update]].
**Despite this, in the [[v1.4.0|Wanted Dead Update]] the season abruptly ended on the 30th of September 2022.
